label: Mature outcomes
method: Synthetic inputs: 300 location-day forecasts, comprising 240 mature outcomes, 40 pending corrections and 20 source gaps. Mature-label coverage is 240/300 = 80%; when 40 pending labels mature it becomes 280/300 ≈ 93.3%. This measures label coverage, not forecast accuracy.

label: Pending corrections
method: Synthetic inputs: 300 location-day forecasts, comprising 240 mature outcomes, 40 pending corrections and 20 source gaps. Mature-label coverage is 240/300 = 80%; when 40 pending labels mature it becomes 280/300 ≈ 93.3%. This measures label coverage, not forecast accuracy.
